AN AI CHATBOT JUST MOVED INTO YOUR THREADS INBOX
slides.body: Users can send any Threads post, image, link, or video straight to Meta AI in a private chat. It answers questions about whatever you share and handles follow-up conversations. The feature rolls out to every country starting Monday

slides.headline: META BURIED AI IN FOUR APPS SO YOU NEVER LEAVE
slides.body: Meta AI already sits inside DMs on Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp. Threads was the last major Meta app without it. The goal: stop users from ever opening ChatGPT or Google Gemini for quick answers

slides.headline: FOUR META APPS NOW ANSWER YOUR CUSTOMERS BEFORE YOU CAN
slides.body: When Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Threads all reply with AI in seconds, nobody waits for a human. Customers get answers from Meta AI before your team even sees the message. The businesses adding their own AI answer every question 24/7 — without hiring anyone
